candidates.change_summary: Change the final returned boolean from true to false so transfer() now returns false after completing calls.
Make transfer() return the success flag of the last external call instead of always true.
Insert an early return false if any call returns false, causing transfer() to return false in that case instead of true.
Change the address used in the require check so a different caller is required, altering which caller can successfully perform transfers.
Multiply the transferred amount by 1 (no change in value) replaced with dividing by 1 to alter arithmetic path and potentially different revert behavior.
Remove the require that _tos.length > 0 so calls with empty arrays succeed and return true, changing observable behavior for empty input.
Change the call target from caddress to msg.sender so the external call is made to the caller, altering which contract is invoked and thus observable behavior.
Stop multiplying by 1e18 (remove the mul_uint256) so the amounts passed to transferFrom are raw v[i], changing the transfer amounts observed externally.
